analysis_class: post-hoc robustness analysis of frozen predictions

event_context_only.midterms-2022: CPI release November 10, 2022 at 08:30 ET overlaps some holding windows
event_context_only.presidential-2024: FOMC statement November 7, 2024 at 14:00 ET overlaps some holding windows

limits: No new earnings, crash or forward sample was run.
Original agent prompts and evidence-delivery confounds remain.
News gate is an external policy, not an observed agent abstention; charges already incurred remain.
Exposure controls match invested fraction, not factor risk or volatility.
No existing holdings, tax lots, intraday fills, spreads or market impact estimates.
Second-close stress shifts entry and exit together and does not measure millisecond latency.
Fixed long-only targets are allocation rules, not executable orders from the agents.

profiles.half-exposure-cap: Scale target weights to at most 50% invested
profiles.matched-SPY: SPY at each method's invested fraction; remaining cash
profiles.matched-basket: Equal stock basket at each method's invested fraction
profiles.one-session-late: Second close, 10 bp per side; same five-session hold
profiles.require-archived-news: Do not open agent positions when frozen news is missing

selection: All 60 original cases, all 13 methods; no outcome-based exclusion
